profile.entities: Mobavenue AI Tech Limited; Mobavenue Media Private Limited
profile.subseg: Programmatic Advertising; AI-Driven Performance Marketing; Cross-Screen Media Buying
profile.themes: AI-driven outcome optimization; Global expansion (UK/LATAM); Rule of 50 growth philosophy

bull_bear.body: INR49.99cr preferential raise allocated to AI infrastructure, global expansion, and selective inorganic tech opportunities; disciplined approach; no dividends or buybacks mentioned
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Global macro: geopolitical conflicts, oil price volatility, inflation; client concentration risk (no top client >10% disclosed); execution risk in global scaling; regulatory compliance in new markets
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident, forward-looking, disciplined; emphasis on AI-driven compounding, Rule of 50 (30%+ revenue growth, 20%+ EBITDA margin), and long-term value creation; tone reflects transition from legacy media broker to AI-native platform company
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: Revenue per outcome increased 7.7% Q1 to Q4 (INR44.99 → INR48.44) — a hidden proxy for pricing power and AI efficiency; 125 crore daily signals processed and 50TB trained in 1hr — industrial-scale AI moat not visible in traditional metrics
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body: India: 88.5% revenue; International: 11.5% revenue (UK live, LATAM scaling); Direct clients: 73.9% of revenue; Premium formats (CTV, video): growing share; Verticals: Quick Commerce, Fintech, Retail strongest; Travel recovering post-Q3 dip
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

latest_quarter.body: EBITDA margin improved to 20.8% (FY26) from prior levels; supply/data cost remained flat at ~60% of revenue; employee cost up 20.1% YoY but disciplined relative to revenue growth; other expenses down 8.9% YoY
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: revenue growth: directional expectation of sequential momentum; margin: sustained >20% EBITDA; order inflow: not specified; capex/commissioning: asset-light model, no capex disclosed, focus on AI Labs and cloud infrastructure
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: Global expansion into Asia and other developed markets; selective M&A for tech/capability enhancement; supply-side monetization and MarTech adjacents; AI-driven autonomous campaign workflows
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Mobavenue achieved disciplined, broad-based growth in FY26 with revenue up 41.9% YoY in Q4 and EBITDA margin expanding to 20.8%, driven by AI-native platform improvements and enterprise client depth; what matters is the closed-loop P3 AI architecture enabling rising revenue per outcome (INR48.44 in Q4) and the shift from media intermediary to outcome-led tech platform with global scalability.
